notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.87

• Passkeys work in DuckWeb. Sites can make a passkey on this phone and sign you in with it, after the phone's lock.
• Use another phone or tablet: when this phone has no passkey for a site, DuckOS shows a QR code. Scan it with the iPhone, Android phone or tablet that has the passkey. Apps get the same choice in Android's sign-in sheet.
• DuckStore installs the apps you pick straight away, without Android asking each time.
• Settings > Apps > an app: each permission has its own switch now.
• "Hey Duck" lets go of the microphone while another app records, so WhatsApp voice messages and calls hear you.
• DuckWallet has animations: cards rise in, fly open when tapped, and shrink away when removed.
• Settings > Updates shows Preparing, Installing and Verifying in your language.
